Rule_Condition_IF: found=true IF customer makes a CLEAR, SPECIFIC, COMMITTED promise to pay the FULL balance by a SPECIFIC DATE
Rule_Action_THEN: Return populated action record with amount, date, notes, description, delivery_channel (default Email)
Validation_or_Control: Require explicit date + full-balance language; partial -> ACT005; conditional -> ACT007
Exception_Action: Do NOT fire for vague language; route to ACT005 or ACT007 where applicable
Notes: Must be full balance + explicit date; partials -> ACT005; conditional payment -> ACT007

Rule_Condition_IF: found=true IF customer requests or agrees to callback from senior/manager/supervisor OR agent escalates call
Rule_Action_THEN: Return populated action record with notes, escalation_level (default L1), escalated_to_role, target_resolution_date, due_by
Validation_or_Control: Default escalation_level to L1 when unspecified; extract exact role/date when present
Exception_Action: If no escalation -> found=false; still capture other actions if present
Notes: Escalation includes both customer request and agent-initiated escalation

Rule_Condition_IF: found=true IF customer contests or challenges a charge/invoice or service not delivered
Rule_Action_THEN: Return populated action record with dispute_reason, invoice_number, resolution_status (default Pending)
Validation_or_Control: Default resolution_status=Pending; require explicit contesting language; extract invoice number when present
Exception_Action: If not a dispute -> found=false; escalate to manual review if ambiguous
Notes: Examples in prompt show phrasing to match; invoice id extraction recommended

Rule_Condition_IF: found=true IF customer requests a document be sent (email/post/other)
Rule_Action_THEN: Return populated action record with documents_requested, document_type, delivery_channel (default Email)
Validation_or_Control: Default delivery_channel Email; separate from ACT008; capture regardless of fulfillment
Exception_Action: Treat as request even if agent says cannot send; capture as ACT004
Notes: Documents_requested as list; channel fallback to Email

Rule_Condition_IF: found=true IF customer commits to paying a SPECIFIC AMOUNT LESS THAN full balance
Rule_Action_THEN: Return populated action record with amount, date, payment_method
Logic_or_Matching_Method: Prompt-based numeric and date extraction via run_tool
Validation_or_Control: ACT005 ALWAYS takes priority over ACT001 when amount is partial
Exception_Action: If amount partial but ambiguous -> mark found=false and flag for manual review
Notes: Explicit amount required; payment method optional

Rule_Condition_IF: found=true WHEN customer says they CANNOT or WILL NOT make any payment (initial refusal)
Rule_Action_THEN: Return populated action record with notes, settlement_amount, settlement_due_date
Logic_or_Matching_Method: Trigger-phrase matching + semantic detection; must fire first and coexist with others
Validation_or_Control: MUST fire first for initial refusal; coexists with other actions; capture settlement details if present
Exception_Action: Always fire even if later commitments occur; record coexistence with other actions
Notes: Initial refusal must be retained even if later changed

Rule_Condition_IF: found=true IF customer asks for discount/credit/adjustment OR makes payment conditional on receiving credit
Rule_Action_THEN: Return populated action record with requested_amount, reason, requested_date
Validation_or_Control: Conditional payment statements ALWAYS trigger ACT007
Exception_Action: Conditional payments always mapped to ACT007 even if subsequent actions occur
Notes: Requested_amount may be percentage or currency; reason extracted

Rule_Condition_IF: found=true FOR any customer request NOT covered by ACT001–ACT007
Rule_Action_THEN: Return populated action record with request_details, preferred_time
Logic_or_Matching_Method: Prompt-based classification into catch-all request category
Validation_or_Control: Separate from ACT004 when both inquiry and send-request exist; create both
Exception_Action: If overlapping with other ACTs, split into separate actions as specified
Notes: Catch-all; ensure not to conflate with payment/credit/escalation/dispute/docs

Rule_Condition_IF: found=true IF customer provides updated contact info or requests contact info update (differs from system)
Rule_Action_THEN: Return populated action record with request_details, preferred_time
Validation_or_Control: Fire when user provides correct contact details differing from system; require presence of new contact data for validation
Exception_Action: If ambiguous or conflicting contact info -> flag for verification; do not auto-apply without verification
Notes: ACT009 is specialized for contact updates

Rule_Condition_IF: Rules & instructions defined in LISA system prompt for initial call: verification, debt statement, payment scenarios, special requests, refusal handling, closing summary
Rule_Action_THEN: Use as system prompt for voice agent; guide verification, what to say and when
Logic_or_Matching_Method: Static prompt rules + dynamic context insertion; enforcement via runtime prompt
Validation_or_Control: Must verify identity before disclosing PII; date calculation via calculate_date helper
Exception_Action: If wrong person -> end call; if email unknown -> escalate for verification
Audit_Evidence: Generated system prompt string used in get_prompt; logged when call starts

Rule_Condition_IF: Follow-up call rules: contextual continuity, handling missed promises, disputes, renegotiation, special requests, closing summary
Rule_Action_THEN: Use as system prompt for follow-up voice agent; reference previous interaction
Logic_or_Matching_Method: Static prompt rules + dynamic context insertion; enforcement via runtime prompt
Validation_or_Control: Must reference previous interaction context in greeting; privacy rules apply
Exception_Action: If info missing -> avoid inventing data; escalate for account updates
Audit_Evidence: Generated system prompt string used in get_prompt; logged when call starts
Notes: Focused on follow-up and continuity; uses previous call context

Rule_Condition_IF: Sets up live pipeline, selects system prompt (call_one/call_two) based on user_data.call_type, runs LLM/STT/TTS, records transcript, and reports results
Rule_Action_THEN: Configure transports, LLM/STT/TTS services; run pipeline; capture tool calls and messages
Logic_or_Matching_Method: Runtime orchestration code using Pipecat pipeline and LLM services; tool call capture via assistant_aggregator
Validation_or_Control: Validate system_prompt generation success; log failures and audio recording status
Exception_Action: On script generation failure -> log and raise; on audio upload failure -> log and continue/raise as appropriate
Audit_Evidence: Call transcript and recording info saved via blob_manager; report_call_result invoked
Notes: Orchestrates real-time voice agent; integrates prompts
